newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Petronas aims for downstream role in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Petronas aims for downstream role in Vietnam.

text.p: Malaysian state-oil firm Petronas will continue to press for refining and marketing opportunities in the growing Vietnam energy market, Petronas President Dato Mohamed Hassan Marican said on Tuesday.

"We remain bullish on investment in the downstream in Vietnam...We continue to discuss (it) with the Vietnamse authorities," Marican told reporters on the sidelines of an energy conference in Abu Dhabi.
Vietnam's government has rejected proposals made by foreign partners concerning a refinery in the country and has said it will conduct a new feasibility study into the project.
Petronas has oil and gas interests in Vietnam and has plans to develop a gasoline station network in the country that could be supplied by the proposed foreign joint venture refinery.
Marican declined to give details on the size of any future refinery stake that Petronas wanted.
